[ok] Copied 7 files to components/astryx/Kbd/

What @astryxdesign/core exports is imported from @astryxdesign/core; the internal modules the component needs are copied beside it.
You can now customize the component source freely.

Copied beside it: ../utils/isApplePlatform.ts, ../i18n/englishFallback.ts, ../i18n/useComponentTranslator.ts, ../i18n/generated-english/Kbd/Kbd.generated.ts, ../utils/sharedRealm.ts (in the package's folder layout; imported by relative path)

It imports these npm packages; install any your project lacks: @stylexjs/stylex@"^0.19.0" react@">=19.0.0"

Marked components/astryx/ with astryx-swizzle.json: with @astryxdesign/build's Babel, PostCSS and Vite integrations, or withAstryx() under webpack, every module under it compiles below your theme, so theme overrides reach the copy. Keep only swizzled copies there. Turbopack does not read the marker yet.

! These components use StyleX and require a StyleX compiler in your build.
  Without one, importing them throws "Unexpected 'stylex.create' call at runtime"
  and the page does not render. See setup per framework:
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling
  Next.js note: the StyleX Babel plugin disables SWC and breaks next/font -
  use an SWC-based StyleX transform instead (covered in the guide).

Customizing a component often signals a gap in the design system.
Let the maintainers know what you needed:
  https://github.com/meta/astryx/issues/new
